William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

On Friends and Foes

Mr. Cromek to Mr. Stothard: Fortune favours the brave, old proverbs say

XIX
F
ORTUNE
 favours the brave, old proverbs say;
But not with money; that is not the way.
Turn back! turn back! you travel all in vain;
Turn through the iron gate down Sneaking Lane.
